title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
abstract: arXiv:2611.31216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. translated_title: LeJEPA特征并非各向同性，也不应各向同性
translated_abstract: LeJEPA中的SIGReg项将特征正则化为各向同性的高斯分布。我们的第一个结果表明，该正则化器在实践中无法真正实现这一目标。我们设计了一个改进的正则化器以更好地实现该目标，并带来了轻微的性能提升。例如，在ImageNet-100上，我们改进的正则化器以少1.3倍的训练轮数达到了SIGReg的最终精度。我们的第二个结果论证了自监督编码器的特征不应是各向同性的高斯分布。我们证明LeJEPA中的对齐项与SIGReg存在冲突，因为它将特征的幅度与其方向耦合在一起，而各向同性高斯特征要求幅度与方向相互独立。事实上，LeJEPA得到的特征并不是各向同性的。因此LeJEPA存在两个问题：其正则化器较弱，且各向同性高斯目标过于严格。我们的第三个结果关于对各向同性的重新表述（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明LeJEPA的SIGReg正则化器在实践中无法实现各向同性高斯目标且该目标本身过于严格，提出改进的正则化器使训练加速约1.3倍，并论证自监督特征本就不应是各向同性的高斯分布。
